In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 7

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpmisc)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

colCelltypes <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
names(colCelltypes) <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

## Seurat Object

```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```

## Obs

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```

## IL-17

```{r}
il17.paths <- list.files("data/decoupler/il17/wsum_kegg", full.names = T)
il17.paths
```

```{r}
il17.list <- lapply(il17.paths, function(thispath) read_csv(thispath, show_col_types = F))

il17.df <- plyr::ldply(il17.list)

il17.df

il17.sets <- il17.df %>% colnames %>% setdiff(., "barcode")
il17.sets

il17.names <- c("Antimicrobial", "Chemokine", "Cytokine", "Remodeling")
names(il17.names) <- il17.sets
il17.names

il17.df <- il17.df %>% rename_with(~il17.names[.x], .cols = starts_with("il17af"))
il17.df
```

```{r}
obs.dc <- il17.df %>% 
  left_join(obs.dc %>% rownames_to_column("barcode"), .,  by = "barcode")

obs.dc %>% select(colnames(il17.df))
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(
  seuobj,
  il17.df %>% 
    column_to_rownames("barcode")
)
seuobj@meta.data
```

# IL-17 Activity

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs.dc %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>%  droplevels,
  features = unname(il17.names),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  mutate(featureVar = fct_relevel(featureVar, il17.names)) %>% 
  group_by(celltype, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = celltype, y = meanVal)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", aes(color = celltype), lwd = 1, fill = "gray80") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, position = position_jitter(width = 0.3, seed = thisseed), aes(fill = diagSub), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  facet_grid(~featureVar, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colCelltypes) +
  labs(
    y = "Gene Set Mean Score",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  ) + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
```

```{r, fig.width=30, fig.height=5}
SenderReceiver(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  senderCol = "cellsubtype",
  senderVal = "Thelper",
  features.sender = c("IL17A"),
  senderProp = FALSE,
  senderRelative = "cellsubtype",
  minSenderFreq = 10,
  receiverCol = "celltype",
  receiverVal = c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid"),
  features.receiver = unname(il17.names),
  receiverProp = FALSE,
  receiverRelative = "celltype",
  minReceiverFreq = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_x",
  facet_dir = "v",
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  ncol = 4,
  stripSize = 14,
  axisXsize = 16,
  axisYsize = 16,
  regSize = 5,
  groupReg = F,
  fillReg = F,
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>%
  mutate(receiverName = case_when(
    receiverName == "ColEpi_Antimicrobial" ~ "ColEpi - Antimicrobial",
    receiverName == "ColEpi_Chemokine" ~ "ColEpi - Chemokine",
    receiverName == "Stroma_Chemokine" ~ "Stroma - Chemokine",
    receiverName == "Stroma_Remodeling" ~ "Stroma - Remodeling",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Antimicrobial" ~ "Myeloid - Antimicrobial",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Chemokine" ~ "Myeloid - Chemokine",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Cytokine" ~ "Myeloid - Cytokine",
    receiverName == "Myeloid_Remodeling" ~ "Myeloid - Remodeling"
  )) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(receiverName)) %>% 
  mutate(receiverName = fct_relevel(receiverName, c(
    "ColEpi - Antimicrobial",
    "ColEpi - Chemokine",
    "Stroma - Chemokine",
    "Stroma - Remodeling",
    "Myeloid - Antimicrobial",
    "Myeloid - Chemokine",
    "Myeloid - Cytokine",
    "Myeloid - Remodeling"
  ))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = receiverExp, x = senderExp)) +
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm", lwd=2.5, color =  "#3366FF") +
  stat_poly_eq(method = "lm", use_label(c("R2", "P")),
               rsquared.conf.level = 0.9999, size = 8) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), shape = 21, size = 4.5, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 1.5) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  facet_grid(~receiverName, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Mean IL17A Gene Expression (Thelper)", 
    y = "Gene Set Mean Score", 
    size = "# Cells", 
    shape = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 23, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.25, 0.5, 0.25, 0.25), "cm")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs.dc %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>%  droplevels,
  features = c("Antimicrobial", "Chemokine"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  filterCol = "celltype",
  filterVal = c("ColEpi"),
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T,
)  %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, celltype, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), aes(fill = diagSub)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, label = "p.format", vjust = 1.6, size = 4.5, tip.length = 0.05) +
  facet_grid(~featureVar, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    y = "Mean Gene Set Score\nin Colonic Epithelium",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```


```{r}
p20.tojoin <- p20 %>% 
  filter(str_ends(colon_site_ihc, "-2", negate = T)) %>% # remove 2nd 001-047 sample
  filter(participant_id %in% obs$participant_id) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(colon_site_ihc_p20 = colon_site_ihc) %>% 
  select(participant_id, colon_site_ihc_p20, colon_site_rna, area, `BCMA+`:`NCR1+`) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = `BCMA+`:`NCR1+`, names_to = "marker", values_to = "density")
  
p20.tojoin
```

```{r}
il17.tojoin <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs.dc %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>%  droplevels,
  features = il17.names,
  relative.to = "celltype",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
```


```{r}
il17.p20 <- inner_join(il17.tojoin, p20.tojoin, by = "participant_id") %>% 
    mutate(concordance = case_when(
    participant_id %in% p20.unknown ~ "Not specified",
    participant_id %in% p20.discordant ~ "Discordant",
    participant_id %notin% c(p20.discordant, p20.unknown) ~ "Concordant" 
  ),
  .after = participant_id) %>% 
  arrange(biopsy)

il17.p20
```

```{r}
  mutate(density.mean = mean(density)) %>% 
  distinct(participant_id, area, marker, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  ungroup
```

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=4}
p20.tojoin %>% 
  filter(marker == "MPO+" & area %in% c("EPI", "LP")) %>%
```
